coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 2 of the 8 ground-truth variable specifications (25%): both query directions and retrieval accuracy measured through correct answers and target log-probabilities.
coverage.design_error_analysis: Replaces the IMDb top-1000/GPT-4-verified dataset with Wikidata cohorts and substitutes a different model suite. Does not specify the required fixed evaluation scripts or explicitly compare chat-based versus completion-based interaction. Uses fixed temperature 0 rather than model-dependent temperature settings, and replaces t-tests and Kolmogorov–Smirnov tests with other statistical tests.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty, so it does not semantically match the expected conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Fails to provide the expected finding of higher child-to-parent retrieval performance and significantly lower parent-to-child performance, confirming the reversal curse.
